contract: CONTRACT.md — clinical/editorial clinic website; physician, address and call action first; real assets; preserve draft status and routes. Shared working tree also contains concurrent UI refinements; captures describe the rendered state at review time.

accessibility.evidence: Rendered home Lighthouse snapshot accessibility 100, best practices 100. Mobile menu opened, Escape closed and returned focus; visible solid focus outline. Native FAQ opens. Primary phone targets 51–56px, menu 48px. Reduced-motion stylesheet rule present. Automated audit is not full WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: Rendered home at all three exact viewports had scrollWidth <= innerWidth; real portrait loaded at naturalWidth 960. Inspected mobile/tablet and desktop screenshots. Contact form at 360px had no horizontal overflow.

loading.reason: No asynchronous booking flow or loading view; static page and explicit preview form only.

empty.evidence: Empty gallery absent. FAQ search with zzzz-no-match displayed no-results text and suggested another keyword.

error.evidence: Changed portrait source in isolated browser DOM to invalid data URL; actual image load error displayed fallback text and retained 304.8px frame height. Source files were not changed by this test.

partial.evidence: Real name/address/phone displayed; unknown hours and proposed service scope explicitly labelled. Preview form collapsed by default with preview status in summary.

success.evidence: Valid preview form explicitly said nothing was sent and no appointment confirmed. Invalid blank form rejected; localStorage remained empty. Background Kaspersky extension XHR observed; not an application booking request.

permission.reason: Site requests no geolocation/device permissions and has no authenticated backend actions. External map/call links inspected, no call placed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Browser DOM measurements from exact viewport: no horizontal overflow, heading and photo dimensions, call target dimensions. Screenshots reviewed in tool output.
